digest.en: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Kenya's elephant deaths due to cyanide poisoning dominate the headlines. Meanwhile, the US military denies involvement in Iranian attacks, while Washington is urged to reevaluate its security role in the Gulf. Russian students face university spot shortages.
